d:
Jabalpur Outer Ring Road Project is one of the major highway infrastructure projects being developed by NHAI in Madhya Pradesh.
In this video, we take you on an aerial journey of the *114 KM long, 4-Lane Jabalpur Outer Ring Road,* being developed at an estimated cost of approximately *₹3,540 Crore.*
The project is designed to provide better connectivity between NH-45, NH-34, NH-30 and SH-37A while allowing long-distance traffic to bypass the busy areas of Jabalpur city.
